skill.name: Retrieve Wrappable OpenAI Methods List
skill.description: Enumerate and return all OpenAI methods eligible for instrumentation wrapping, excluding streaming-specific methods (Chat Completions, Responses API). Used to configure which methods receive instrumentation hooks during setup.
skill.skill_body:
Identify all OpenAI API methods that should be wrapped for instrumentation. Return a list of WrapConfig objects representing non-streaming methods. Exclude Chat Completions and Responses API methods, as these are handled separately in custom wrapping logic to support streaming.

## Objective

Identify and enumerate methods eligible for instrumentation wrapping
## Applicable Signals

- Instrumentation setup routine invoked
- Method wrapping configuration requested
- OpenAI instrumentation initialization started

## Contraindications

- Streaming methods must be included in the result
- Instrumentation is disabled or not active
- Method list is already cached and does not need refresh

## Workflow Steps

- Initialize empty list for wrapped methods
- Enumerate standard OpenAI methods available in current version
- Filter out Chat Completions and Responses API methods
- Check for beta API methods and include if available
- Convert each method to WrapConfig object
- Return complete list of WrapConfig objects

## Constraints

- Chat Completions and Responses API methods must be excluded
- Only non-streaming methods should be enumerated
- Result must be compatible with WrapConfig structure

## Cautions

- Ensure version-specific method availability is checked before wrapping
- Beta APIs may not be available in all OpenAI versions

## Output Contract

- Returns a list of WrapConfig objects representing all non-streaming OpenAI methods eligible for instrumentation wrapping. List must be non-empty and contain only methods that are not Chat Completions or Responses API variants.
